notes: IFRS. Formula applied as-is; treat with caution, it is not like-for-like with operating companies. (1) Revenue is mostly the telecom and internet business (SoftBank Corp. / LY Corp.) and Arm; the SoftBank Vision Funds and Investment Business of Holding Companies book their results as gains on investments below net sales, and their buying and selling of investments sits in investing (e.g. payments for acquisition of investments 1,625,245; SVF 578,927), so the investment arms barely enter paidOut except through their operating costs and the holding company's interest. (2) Interest paid (482,111) is inside OCF, so it is already in paidOut via revenue − OCF; much of it is holding-company interest on debt that funds investments, not on the operating business. (3) OCF is lowered by 769,572 of investment purchases by asset-management subsidiaries (flag investmentPurchasesInOCF), inflating paidOut by about 9.7%. (4) Banking and card finance flows of PayPay Bank / PayPay Card presumably sit in OCF but are not separately disclosed (flag financeReceivablesInOCF, amount null). (5) Net sales include ¥202,964 million of non-IFRS 15 revenue such as lease contracts in the Finance and Enterprise businesses. Taxes paid are gross of 164,847 refunds; both in OCF. Lease principal (186,441) noted, not added.
